thread:
sam.h: Heads-up — vendor pushed calypso-12b weights to their release page under a 'Community-Modified-1.0' license. Asked if we can quantize + ship derivatives and/or host as a Redwood-hosted model. Need quick legal read before we onboard to model catalog.  
morgan: link? and can you paste the license text?  
sam.h: https://example.com/calypso/releases/v1.0  
sam.h: license snippet: ```
Community-Modified-1.0
You may modify and redistribute this software and derivative weights. Attribution to original authors required. Redistribution of compiled/derivative binaries is permitted provided NOTICE file is included. No sublicensing of upstream copyright granted.
```  
anya.legal: quick take: sounds permissive-ish but has attribution + NOTICE requirement. "No sublicensing" line is hairy — need to interpret if shipping quantized weights in a binary blob counts as sublicensing.  
morgan: does quantization = derivative? we usually treat quantized weights as derived work.  
anya.legal: yes, quantized weights are a derivative in our view. Redistribution of those weights likely triggers the NOTICE + attribution clauses. The "no sublicensing" wording could mean you can't relicense the upstream under a new license; it doesn't necessarily prohibit distribution, but it depends on how they define "sublicense" elsewhere. I'd like to see the full license file.  
eli.infra: for Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private: hosting behind API is not the same as shipping weights. But Dedicated (we ship reserved images) or Private (we deliver containers/on-prem) may be counted as redistribution if we include the quantized weights in the image we provide to a customer.  
nora.devex: product question — if we host but don't ship weights (just inference), we can attach upstream attribution in model metadata / UI. Is that sufficient from compliance POV?  
anya.legal: often yes — for hosted inference, including attribution/NOTICE in the model card + providing a link to the original repo satisfies the redistribution/NOTICE obligations. But if the license requires that recipients of redistributed binaries have the ability to access the NOTICE in the same distribution, we must ensure UI/FAQ/metadata persist that info.  
morgan: so for Dedicated/reserved images where customer gets the container: that's redistribution and we would be distributing a derivative binary. We need explicit clearance or to ensure the license allows it with attribution.  
anya.legal: correct. Action items: (1) I'll request a clarification from the vendor if "no sublicensing" prevents shipping quantized binaries. (2) For immediate safety, mark calypso-12b as "hosted-read-only: allowed with attribution" in the model catalog, and block adding it to Dedicated or Private delivery until we get written permission.  
sam.h: +1. For eval/bench we can run internal quantization experiments on infra, right? not redistributing.  
anya.legal: internal benchmarking is fine. Just ensure models/artifacts don't get exported into release images or customer deliverables.  
eli.infra: I'll add a catalog flag and update the hosting pipeline to inject the required NOTICE file into the model metadata UI when calypso is enabled behind the hosted API.  
nora.devex: I'll update the quickstart template to display attribution and a link to the vendor README.  
morgan: logging the vendor contact: vendor@calypso.ai, asked for confirmation.  
legal-bot: Reminder — created ticket LEG-5123 to track vendor clarification and change control.  
anya.legal: If vendor responds with "yes you can redistribute with NOTICE", we still need to (A) include the NOTICE verbatim in the container + model card, (B) include attribution strings in UI/response headers where feasible, and (C) update our reseller/redistribution checklist.  
sam.h: thanks — will pause Distributed/Dedicated onboarding until LEG-5123 cleared.  
morgan: tagging @security for any export-control concerns?  
anya.legal: quick note: also verify whether any upstream checkpoint includes third-party data or model weights with extra restrictions. I'll add that to the ticket.  
sam.h: appreciate it. will post updates from vendor here. :thumbsup:
